{{Quote|That's ''enough'' excitement for me, Obi-Wan. I need a ''day off''.''"<br />"''Anakin, this ''was'' your day off&mdash;remember?|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Leisure">{{TCWComicCite|6.22|Leisure}}</ref>}}
A '''leisure satellite''' was a type of [[Space station/Legends|space station]] employed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Passengers would come aboard the [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] for various activities, often while the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
